description: Look up a UK company on Companies House: search by name to find candidates, or fetch one by its number for the public record, its directors and its filing dates. Needs no account. Without an account it is UK only.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

company_number.description: Exact company number to fetch the full record + directors + deadlines. Use once you know the number (e.g. after the user confirms a search candidate).

query.description: Company name to search for (returns up to ~10 candidates with number, status, and address). Use when you have a name but not a number.

name: lookup_company
title: Lookup Company
